title: Success through Achieving vs Authenticity — Success: Part 5
summary: Part 5 of the Success series. Kahran shares stories of his grandfather SSH Rehman, former director of ITC and leader of ITC Hotels, while Divya pokes at Bryan Johnson's longevity routine and the idea of quality years vs maximum years. They argue about whether finiteness is the constraint or the gift, and how a deadline-driven academic mindset compares to the open-ended creative work of an MFA.

intents.display: to think about quality years vs maximizing how long you live
to hear stories about grandparents who built something lasting
